channelTitle: Wired at bedtime? Grandma's chamomile tea
hook: Mind racing right when you're trying to fall asleep? Grandma always had a pot of chamomile tea ready.
remedy: As old-fashioned home wisdom, a warm cup of chamomile tea before bed has been a go-to wind-down ritual for generations — the warmth and gentle floral taste can help you feel calm enough to drift off.
steps: Steep a chamomile tea bag in hot water for 5 to 7 minutes
Add a little honey if you like it sweeter
Sip it slowly about 30 minutes before bed
caution: Skip it if you're allergic to ragweed, daisies, or related plants, and check with your doctor first if you take blood thinners.
cta: Follow along for more old-school home remedies
